query: SELECT t.thread_id AS "thread_id!: String", w.start_epoch AS "start_epoch?: i64", w.start_position AS "start_position?: i64", COALESCE(w.active,0) AS "active!: i64", f.epoch AS "assigning_epoch?: i64" FROM threads t LEFT JOIN thread_watches w ON w.reader_actor=? AND w.thread_id=t.thread_id LEFT JOIN project_feed f ON f.position=w.start_position WHERE t.thread_id>? AND COALESCE(w.active,0)!=0 ORDER BY t.thread_id LIMIT ?
